definitions.explanation: The traditional Japanese martial art of fighting with a sword. Refers to practical combat techniques with a real sword, as distinct from the modern sport of kendo.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{剣|けん}→剣：11819_ken⟧ (sword) + ⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧ (technique/art). Refers to traditional Japanese sword-fighting techniques, especially those developed by samurai during the feudal period.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {剣術|けんじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{稽古|けいこ}→稽古：00210_keiko⟧: sword practice
- {剣術|けんじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{達人|たつじん}→達人：14378_tatsujin⟧: master swordsman
- {剣術|けんじゅつ}⟦{道場|どうじょう}→道場：14326_doujou⟧: swordsmanship dojo
- {剣術|けんじゅつ}⟦{流派|りゅうは}→流派：13365_ryuuha⟧: school of swordsmanship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧: kendo — the modern competitive sport derived from swordsmanship, using bamboo swords and protective armor
- {居合|いあい}: iaido/iaijutsu — the art of drawing and cutting with a sword in a single motion
- ⟦{武術|ぶじゅつ}→武術：13244_bujutsu⟧: martial arts — a broader term covering all fighting arts

{剣術|けんじゅつ} emphasizes practical combat technique with a real blade, while ⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧ is the modern sport form focused on character development.
